source: Traced by hand and by color from USGS NAIP aerial photos (public domain), to fill in what OpenStreetMap doesn't have yet.

unsure.all: Woodmont has more than one nine in these photos; I took the nine the map numbers 10-18 because its lengths and pars match this card (the map's 1-9 is a different nine). The walk from the 1st green to the 2nd tee crosses the road (about 270 m).
